jobs.description: Important: This is a contract/part-time role: 10-20 hrs/week - rate $40-50/hr NOPE is an AI safety company with a unique goal; we do not concern ourselves with bio or cyber-risks or other Hollywood-ized alignment fantasies. We are concerned instead with the massive proliferation of relationships between humans and AI and how this affects our wellbeing and societal fabrics. Billions of conversations between people and AI are accumulating into relationships. This ranges children talking to toys, adults with AI companions, or elderly people engaging with healthcare assistants. We measure real conversations and relationships, and the trajectories of risks involved, and publish what we find, so platforms (and society) can decide when and how to act. We build ML models, track incidents, analyze new regulations, and run evaluations constantly on both raw LLMs and deployed AI. We believe you cannot foster safe and aligned AI without proprer governance and scrutiny into AI as it is truly deployed and productized. The eval space in AI is currently heavily oriented to raw LLM evals unfortuntely. We seek to change that. We seek to hold AI labs and products to account for the harms they produce. Our mission is malleable and always changing, and we search for people who seek to help define that. The Social Comms role : We are doing quite a lot but are very limited on social-and-community-driving capacity. The incidents and regulations we track, the whitepapers, plus our evaluations, are all lacking our commentary and voice. We want to increase our social media presence significantly and start to be a more active participant in the global conversation around AI safety and alignment. As our social-comms person you'd take artifacts and research we produce and weave them into a consistent, human presence on the prevalent social channels: deciding what gets posted, writing it, engaging with the researchers, journalists, builders and policymakers already wrestling with these questions. jobs.title: Why do you want this new job
jobs.description: No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far: Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years. Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance. Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss. Iâm looking for more challenging work. All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills. About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer. If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job. About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job. Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it. In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. A

Next, we are planning to open our brand-new hybrid Fulfilment Center in the Berlin/Brandenburg area (Falkensee). Falkensee will be one of the first sites where we build our internal maintenance function for automated equipment. As Maintenance Operations &amp; Continuous Improvement Manager (m/f/d), you will take strategic ownership of the performance and continuous development of our material handling equipment and maintenance processes on site.</p> <p>You will act as the key interface between the automated and manual processes within the Fulfilment Center, the operational teams, your Maintenance team, our Engineering and Analytics teams, and external partners. You will translate overarching site goals into concrete improvement initiatives, use data to identify optimization opportunities, and ensure that equipment availability, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement remain at a high level in the long term.</p> <p>&nbsp;<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/50pQKpPc24E" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Hands-on leadership:</strong> Lead the Maintenance value stream day-by-day, coaching Maintenance Engineers and Supervisors to effectively lead their teams and ensuring equipment availability targets are met with indirect leadership.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Value Stream Ownership: </strong>Define and execute the long-term performance roadmap, taking full ownership of structural strategy and high-level KPIs across safety, quality, throughput, and operational efficiency.</li> <li><strong>Continuous Improvement &amp; Operational Excellence: </strong>Lead site-wide Kaizen initiatives, Lean methodologies, and root-cause analyses to drive structural process enhancements and embed a culture of continuous improvement.</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven Process &amp; Automation Optimization: </strong>Analyze complex operational and maintenance workflows using data to eliminate bottlenecks, boost system reliability, and improve equipment availability alongside technical teams.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Strategic Alignment: </strong>Act as the strategic bridge between maintenance, our suppliers, planning, analysts, and operations to ensure seamless, end-to-end operational flow.</li> <li><strong>Operational Standards &amp; Governance: </strong>Oversee site-wide adherence to safety standards, 5S principles, and operational best practices without getting bogged down in daily engineering management.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you bring</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Master’s degree (MSc) in Supply Chain Management, Engineering, or a related technical field</li> <li>5+ years of experience focused on maintenance, operational strategy, continuous improvement, or process engineering</li> <li>Strong interest in, or exposure to, automation, robotics, and facility maintenance systems</li> <li>Proven track record in applying Lean, Six Sigma, or Kaizen frameworks in high-volume, automated environments</li> <li>High analytical proficiency, with strong capability in data analysis tools (e.g., Tableau, Excel, SQL)</li&g

You’ll be responsible for keeping our Material Handling Equipment running at peak performance, solving malfunctions independently, and implementing improvements. Your insight and initiative are valued, and you’ll coach junior colleagues to elevate the team, ensuring tens of thousands of orders reach families on time every day. During your shift, you take full responsibility for the service and maintenance of our systems.</p> <p>&nbsp;<iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/gqIXD4Z3_uo" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p> <h2><strong>The tricks of the trade&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Troubleshooting malfunctions:</strong> You detect and resolve both electrical and mechanical issues in technical systems, working closely with our operational supervisors.</li> <li><strong>Collaboration with suppliers:</strong> For complex problems, you work directly with machine suppliers to find solutions.</li> <li><strong>Analysis and improvement:</strong> You analyze malfunctions, prevent recurrence, and implement structural improvements.</li> <li><strong>Preventive maintenance:</strong> You perform scheduled preventive maintenance to ensure maximum system availability.</li> <li><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Competitive salary with growth potential:</strong> Starting at €70,000 gross/year, with annual performance reviews designed to drive your personal and financial development.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>About you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You hold a Ausbildung and/or a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (e.g., mechanical engineering, chemical engineering, mechatronics, automation, etc.)</li> <li>You have 7+ years of experience in a technical or maintenance role</li> <li>You have hands-on knowledge of electrical and mechanical systems, including measurement and camera systems</li> <li>You have been working with software tools such as CMMS and/or ICS/SCADA tools</li> <li>You have strong communication skills and enjoy collaborating in a team</li> <li>At the same time, you are independent, take initiative, and solve problems in a goal-oriented way</li> <li>You're fluent in English and/or German</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you can look forward to&nbsp;</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Smart Commute: </strong>Choose the way you move. jobs.description: <p>The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.</p> <p>Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App.&nbsp;Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Overview</strong></p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">The Platform team owns the backend behind everything Speechify ships: the public TTS API,&nbsp;payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption tracking, and analytics — serving over 50&nbsp;million users across iOS, Android, Mac, Chrome, and web.</p> <p style="text-align: left;" data-speechify-sentence="">These are systems where correctness compounds. Subscription state has to stay consistent&nbsp;across five clients and two app-store billing systems that each go quiet at the worst moment.&nbsp;Consumption metering has to be exact enough to bill on and cheap enough to run at our&nbsp;request volume. The public TTS API has external customers with their own products&nbsp;depending on our latency and uptime. None of this degrades gracefully — it is either right, or&nbsp;someone gets charged twice.</p> <p data-speechify-sentence="">The job is to make your own job smaller. Every system you own here should need less of&nbsp;you a year from now than it did the day you took it, and the reward for that is a larger one.&nbsp;That is the entire growth path on this team — there is no separate ladder, and no ceiling&nbsp;except the one you stop raising. We are a flat organization: people become leaders here by&nbsp;taking scope and being right about it, fast.</p> <p><strong>What Yo</strong><strong>u’</strong><strong>ll Do</strong></p> <ul> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design, build, and own the APIs behind payments, subscriptions, auth, consumption&nbsp;tracking, and our public TTS API</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Take on services you didn't write and make them faster, cheaper, and harder to break</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Establish that a change is correct before it ships, and leave behind the checks that keep it&nbsp;correct after you've moved on</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Automate the parts of your role that shouldn't need a person, then go take on what that&nbsp;freed you up for</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Turn work you've done once into work the whole team can repeat</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Design B2B and enterprise integrations for customers building on top of us</li> <li data-speechify-sentence="">Work with product, mobile, and web to keep backend architecture ahead of where the&nbsp;product is going</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Ideal Candidate Should Have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven backend experience in TS/Node (required)</li> <li>Direct experience with GCP; working knowledge of AWS, Azure, or another cloud</li> <li>A habit of giving away work you used to own, and something to show for the room it&nbsp;created</li> <li>A daily working setup with AI agents you can describe in detail

jobs.title: Senior Manager, International Indirect Tax
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.<br><br>Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><p><strong>JOB DESCRIPTION</strong></p> <p><strong>Senior Manager, International Indirect Tax</strong></p> <ul> <li>Location: Mon remotely, Tue-Fri in-office (London, Amsterdam, Frankfurt, or Madrid)</li> <li>Reporting to: VP, Tax</li> <li>Reports: no formal direct reports, with broad influence on the global tax organization</li> </ul> <p>At Axon, we are on a mission to Protect Life. We build and deploy technology across public safety and justice, and we hold ourselves to high standards in how we operate — including in how we manage our obligations as a global business.</p> <p><strong>Your Impact</strong></p> <p>Axon is seeking a Senior Manager, International Indirect Tax to lead the company's international VAT and indirect tax function, encompassing all non-US VAT and indirect taxes. The role carries overall responsibility for the quality and accuracy of all indirect tax compliance output, as well as providing advisory support to internal teams on indirect tax matters arising from contracts, new market entry, entity set-up, and tax law changes.</p> <p>The successful candidate will be commercially minded, technically strong across European and global VAT systems, experienced in indirect tax compliance, and confident advising Finance, Legal, and Commercial colleagues without requiring escalation. The role supervises three indirect tax team members, reporting directly to the Vice President, Tax.&nbsp; Experience in a hardware and software business with a complex supply chain is highly desired.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></p> <p><strong>Internal Advisory</strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as the primary point of contact for non-US indirect tax queries across Finance, Legal, and Commercial teams.</li> <li>Liaise with sales teams and other partners to understand upstream sales processes that impact indirect tax operationalization and compliance matters.</li> <li>Advise on the VAT treatment of customer contracts, pricing structures, and invoicing arrangements, working directly with Sales and Legal as required.</li> <li>Provide VAT guidance on new product lines and SKU launches, including taxability assessments and sales tax code assignments in D365.</li> <li>Represent the indirect tax function in e-invoicing projects and regulatory change programmes.</li> <li>Support the business through tax authority audits, enquiries, and disputes.</li> <li>Monitor legislative developments across relevant jurisdictions and communicate implications to the business.</li> <li>Advise and inform management on growing areas of focus in non-US indirect compliance and audits, technology trends and solutions, and process improvements.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compliance Oversight</strong></p> <ul> <li>Review and approve all indirect tax compliance deliverables — VAT returns, Intrastat, OSS, and ESL — across all in-scope jurisdictions, with full accountability for accuracy and submission deadlines.</li>

We're here to build better long-term care.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Eucalyptus is now part of Hims &amp; Hers, the global leader in personalised health and wellness.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Euc is the company behind Juniper, one of the world's largest weight-management programs combining GLP-1 medication with personalised nutrition, movement support, and clinician-led care from prescribers, nurses, health coaches, pharmacists, and dietitians. Starting a treatment that could change your life is a big decision, and often a frightening one. Your job is to help them take the first step.</p> <p>This is a Senior Product Designer role for someone who can make that moment clear, credible and human. You design the surfaces where people decide to start, some of the highest-stakes creative work we have, and you can measure your impact in the number of people who begin.</p> <p><strong><span class="notion-enable-hover" data-token-index="0">In this role, you will:</span></strong></p> <ul> <li>Design every page as an argument. Meet someone where they are in their decision and build a clear, structured argument for why to start, built around them, not a list of features.</li> <li>Translate clinical language into words a patient understands and trusts. Accurate, compliant and human at once.</li> <li>Design dense information like an infographic: communicate a lot, simply. Data visualisation and strong hierarchy in place of walls of text, without losing the detail. Our patients care about the detail, so your job is to convey it clearly, not to oversimplify.</li> <li>Lean on interaction design to carry the detail. Progressive disclosure, reveals and interactive data let people go as deep as they want, without meeting it all at once.</li> <li>Use motion and pacing with intent. You control the rhythm of a page and the beat between steps, so people keep moving.</li> <li>Carry the creative set from our adverts through to the landing page and the touchpoints after it. One unbroken story from ad to conversion.</li> <li>Partner your CRO manager on the optimisation loop. The team uses strategies like zero trust, multi-factor authentication, and granular role-based access controls to safeguard our internal operations.</p> <p><strong>Threat Detection &amp; Response</strong> focuses on protecting the company by building a robust detection and automation platform. We're proactive in our defence, constantly hacking ourselves to improve our security posture and staying ahead of emerging threats. Our goal is to make Tide resilient against the ever-evolving threat landscape.</p> <p>While each area has its own focus, collaboration is key - it's why we share the same Slack channel and hold our standups together as one cohesive team, ensuring alignment and seamless communication across all security functions.</p> <p>As the Head of Product and Identity Security, you'll own two of those three areas, reporting directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) and operating as a peer to the Head of Threat Detection &amp; Response. You'll lead a global team across the UK, Eastern Europe, and India, and you'll stay close to the technology: this is a player-manager role, where credibility is earned by doing the work as well as directing it. jobs.description: <p><strong>Regulatory Affairs Associate, Labelling</strong></p> <p><strong>Cycle Company:</strong> Cycle Pharmaceuticals Ltd</p> <p><strong>Position Summary:</strong> This is a full-time position within the Regulatory Affairs team working in our Cambridge office on a hybrid basis (minimum 3 days in the office).</p> <p><strong>Salary:&nbsp;</strong>£37,000 to £42,000 depending on experience, plus bonus and benefits<strong>.</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Join our Regulatory Affairs team as a Regulatory Affairs Associate, labelling where you'll have the opportunity to develop your experience in one of the most important parts of our business bringing medicines to patients through clear, accurate and compliant product information.</p> <p>In this role, you’ll support day-to-day labelling activities across Cycle’s product portfolio, helping prepare, review, maintain and update product labelling and artwork for different markets. You’ll work closely with colleagues across Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Medical Affairs, Compliance, Product Development, Supply Chain, Legal and Project Management, as well as external partners.</p> <p>This is a great opportunity for someone early in their regulatory affairs career who enjoys detail, accuracy and coordination, and wants to build specialist expertise in labelling across areas including metabolic, immunology, oncology and neurology.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Company</strong></p> <p>At Cycle, we believe that <strong>Every Single Patient Matters</strong>. jobs.description: About Allica Bank Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech. Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers. Kriya sits inside that story as Allica's platform for building new credit products. We already offer invoice finance to mid-market SMEs. We are now evaluating how best to launch unsecured lending products to SMEs, building on the well-known MarketFinance loans franchise, but backed by Allica's balance sheet, cost of funds, and 30,000+ SME customer base. Role Description Small businesses can't afford to wait around. When a cash flow gap or a growth opportunity appears, the SMEs we serve need funding that moves at the same speed they do, which is exactly the gap Kriya's unsecured lending products are built to fill. We are looking for a Commercial Finance BDM to help drive new business across Kriya's unsecured, high-velocity SME lending products. This is an entrepreneurial, high-activity sales role: you'll build and manage your own pipeline of prospects, qualify fast, and take ownership of your numbers. Every conversation with a prospective customer is different, and how well you manage your own pipeline rather than any one big deal is what will make the difference to your results. You will also have Allica’s wider distribution network to make the most of. Prepare reports monthly, quarterly and annually to support regulatory reporting and internal management. Manage fee schedules related to 3rd party lending products. jobs.title: Founding Content Strategist
jobs.description: Meet Siena Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns. It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on. The team We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do. We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock. If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading. The Role Siena is shipping faster than the market can absorb, and the words are not keeping up. The market learns about what we build too late, and when it does, the writing doesn't do the product justice. Today launch content is written by the founders and the growth team between everything else, and nobody owns it. With several product launches back to back over the next two quarters and a Founding Creative Director coming in to own the visuals, we need one person who owns every word Siena puts in front of the market: founder-led LinkedIn, the company voice on socials, launches, blog posts, announcements, the scripts behind our videos. You decide what we say, where, and how often, and then you write it. There is no content team underneath you and no copywriters to hand things to. You make the thing. What You'll Do You own all of Siena's content: if it goes out under the Siena name and the market reads it, you wrote it or you signed off on it. You set the strategy for founder-led LinkedIn and the company's own social accounts, write the posts, and own what they do. You ship every product launch with its words ready, announcement, blog, social sequence and founder posts, working with the Creative Director so the words and the visuals land as one thing. You write the scripts for every product video and marketing video, from the launch film to a 30-second product clip, and the Creative Director brings them to screen. You study trends and top performing posts, in our category and outside it, and turn that into a point of view the team can act on, not a swipe file. You know which content moved something, why, and where to double down, and you kill what doesn't work without being asked. You use AI in every part of the work, research, drafting, analysis, distribution, and move faster than a content team would. Your taste is the final filter. Who You Are The Bar: If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you. Published writing you can show across blog posts, launch announcements, social, and video scripts. You have shipped content as the only writer at a company or brand, with no team or copywriters behind you. You have worked in eCommerce or marketed to consumer brands and understand how their teams operate. Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one. You were writing professionally before the current AI tools, and you can tell the difference between a sentence that sounds right and one that's true. You can point to writing that changed what someone did, e.g. the line that got a head of CX to book the demo, the founder post that got forwarded inside a company, the launch that landed. You use AI in every part of your work and none of it reads like AI. You measure your own work and change course on the evidence, not on taste alone. You have run founder-led or executive content before and can show what it did. Nice to Have: Bonus, not required. CX experience in eCommerce, on the brand side or the vendor side. You have marketed AI, automation, or customer experience products. Not a Fit If: You need a content team or copywriters underneath you to produce output. You think content strategy is a calendar. If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading. The Role Siena needs a PM to own the core of our agent platform, the systems that decide what our agents can do, how well they perform, and how customers can see that performance for themselves. You'll set the roadmap for where the platform's capabilities expand next, build the measurement and testing that make it better over time, and make sure customers always have clear, real visibility into what's happening. You're a strong problem solver first, and you've been a Product Manager in CX, ecommerce, helpdesk, or AI automation. What You'll Do Own the core agent platform end to end, defining what it can do today and where that expands next. Build and ship the evaluation, testing, and monitoring systems that make agent performance measurably better over time. Give customers real-time visibility into what the platform is doing and why, so trust compounds. Design and run journey-level A/B tests across agent flows, and use the results to decide what ships next. Own onboarding so customers reach full platform value quickly, own onboarding and keep compressing the path to full platform value. Run full launch cycles for platform features: internal testing, early access, GA, with customer enablement through webinars, docs, and training. Demo platform wins to customers directly and co-sell alongside sales. Work forward deployed: sit with customers, scope live, ship the improvement. Who You Are The Bar: If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you. You're a strong problem solver, full stop. 3+ years working as a Product Manager in CX, ecommerce, helpdesk, or AI automation. AI-native: you build with Claude, Cursor, v0, or similar as a daily part of how you work, not just something you've tried. Strong Signal: Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one. Experience running structured experiments or A/B tests to improve a product metric, not just intuition-led changes. Technical fluency: you can scope webhook systems, OAuth flows, and complex integrations yourself. Customer confidence: you thrive talking with customers, running demos, and co-selling alongside sales. Nice to Have: Bonus, not required. Experience building trust or visibility features (dashboards, coverage reporting, status pages) for a product customers rely on. jobs.title: Global VP Marketing
jobs.description: 360Learning is entering its next phase of growth. Today, more than 2,500 organizations worldwide use 360Learning to turn internal expertise into business performance. As AI fundamentally reshapes how companies build skills, share knowledge and develop their people, we are evolving our platform, bringing together Collaborative Learning, AI and enterprise-grade learning infrastructure to redefine what modern L&D can deliver. We are now looking for a Global VP Marketing to help shape and accelerate this next chapter. Reporting directly to Benjamin Marchal, our CEO , you will own our global Marketing strategy and organization. Your mandate will go beyond generating demand: you will sharpen our positioning in a rapidly changing market, strengthen our brand and category leadership, and build a high-performing Marketing engine that translates market opportunity into sustainable revenue growth. You will partner closely with Sales, Product and Customer teams to strengthen our go-to-market strategy across our key markets, with a particular focus on accelerating growth in North America. You will bring together Product Marketing, Brand & Content and Demand Generation around clear priorities and shared business outcomes,  from market awareness and positioning to pipeline creation, conversion and revenue impact. jobs.title: Responsable Contrôle Qualité (FinTech) - F/H
jobs.description: Chez Younited, nous pensons que le crédit et les services bancaires devraient être aussi simples, rapides et transparents que tout ce qui fait partie de votre vie numérique. C’est pourquoi nous concevons nos services financiers de cette manière. Nous combinons technologie, données et automatisation pour repenser la façon dont les gens empruntent, paient, épargnent et gèrent leur argent. Plus de 1,5 million de clients utilisent déjà Younited à travers l’Europe. Ce que nous construisons Younited Credit  : un crédit à la consommation instantané, directement accessible aux clients. Younited Pay  : des solutions de paiement en plusieurs fois et de financement intégrées aux parcours clients de nos partenaires. Younited Cashback  : du cashback et des offres personnalisées, enrichis par les données de l’open banking. Younited Bank  : notre offre bancaire du quotidien, actuellement disponible via helios by Younited et en cours de déploiement. Notre ambition est de devenir un partenaire financier auquel les gens font véritablement confiance, en combinant simplicité, transparence et finance responsable. En tant qu’entreprise certifiée B Corp, nous intégrons les enjeux sociaux et environnementaux dans la manière dont nous développons notre activité. Younited en quelques chiffres 4 pays européens, avec près de 50 % de notre activité réalisée en dehors de la France. Environ 500 Younies répartis entre Paris, Rome, Barcelone et Lisbonne. La confiance de grandes entreprises, parmi lesquelles Iliad, Bouygues Telecom, Free, Bpifrance, Apple, N26, Fortuneo, Smeg et Thermomix. Les 5 valeurs qui nous guident Make it simple  : privilégier la simplicité dans les produits, l’expérience client et notre organisation. Faire preuve de transparence. Act as an entrepreneur  : prendre ses responsabilités, jouer collectif, oser essayer et accepter l’échec. Innovate or die  : remettre en question le statu quo, aussi impossible que cela puisse paraître. Faster is better  : privilégier la rapidité à la perfection, et l’alignement au débat. No limit  : viser la lune tout en restant humble. Nous offrons à des personnes passionnées par la résolution de problèmes l’espace nécessaire pour donner le meilleur d’elles-mêmes, au sein d’équipes diverses et inclusives réparties à travers l’Europe. C’est ainsi que nous construisons de meilleurs produits financiers pour nos clients et nos partenaires. Rejoignez Younited et contribuez à construire la prochaine génération de solutions de financement et de services bancaires pour les consommateurs en Europe. Contexte 📄 En tant que Responsable   du Contrôle Qualité , tu seras rattaché.e à l’équipe  Ops Excellence et tu seras responsable du pilotage et de la bonne exécution du dispositif de contrôle permanent de 1er niveau sur l’ensemble des processus opérationnels crédit consommation et bancaires de la Business Unit France. Dans ce cadre, tu construiras le plan de contrôle de 1er niveau et tu t’assureras de sa bonne exécution opérationnelle via le management d’une équipe de 4 contrôleurs qualité . Tu veilleras ainsi à la maîtrise des risques opérationnels, à la conformité réglementaire et à la qualité de traitement des opérations en interaction avec les équipes Opérations, Risques, Compliance et Contrôle interne. Missions 🚀 1) Pilotage du dispositif de contrôle permanent Construire le plan de contrôle de 1er niveau sur l’ensemble des processus Structurer le référentiel de contrôles et les méthodologies associées, en cohérence avec les guidelines Groupe S’assurer de la mise à jour des référentiels documentaires Garantir la couverture des risques opérationnels identifiés dans la cartographie des risques 2) Analyse des écarts et amélioration continue Analyser les écarts détectés lors des contrôles et évaluer leurs impacts opérationnels et réglementaires Définir, mettre en œuvre et suivre les plans d’actions correctifs avec les équipes opérationnelles Identifier les défaillances

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>Who We Are</strong></h3> <p>Verkada is transforming how organizations protect their people and places with an integrated, privacy-sensitive AI-powered platform that includes solutions for video security, access control, air quality sensors, alarms, intercoms, and visitor management.&nbsp;</p> <p>We’ve got serious momentum in the market: more than 30,000 customers (including 100+ of the Fortune 500), <a href="https://www.cnbc.com/2025/12/03/verkada-capitalg-valuation-security.html">a $5.8B valuation</a>, more than $1 billion in annualized bookings, and backing from CapitalG, Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst, Felicis Ventures, Next47 and more. Physical AI is one of the most consequential technology shifts of our time, and Verkada is at the center of it.</p> <p>You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. jobs.description: Wanna join the adventure? Loft's AI for Space group is building the stack that runs real machine learning in orbit; turning raw sensor data into decisions on the satellite itself, so insight reaches the customer in minutes instead of hours. The AI Engineering team is where models meet the spacecraft. We own the full path from a partner's trained model to something that actually runs — fast — on flight hardware: compiling ONNX models into optimized engines for each accelerator, the Space Inference Engine and its execution providers, the SDK that packages models for flight, and the perf tooling that proves a model fits its power, thermal, and latency budget before it ever leaves the ground. As we open the platform to a growing roster of defense and Earth-observation partners, the team's scope and the range of silicon we target are expanding fast. As our ML Runtime Engineer , you'll own model compilation and the performance tooling behind it. We're looking for someone scrappy — the kind of engineer who takes an unfamiliar model and an unforgiving power budget, digs into the graph, and gets it running on real hardware without waiting for the path to be handed to them. jobs.description: Lieu : Lyon, Paris ou Bruxelles (selon le profil) Date souhaitée de démarrage : 04/01/2027 Durée : CDI                                                                 Handicap International / Humanité & Inclusion (HI) est une association de solidarité internationale indépendante et impartiale, qui intervient dans les situations de pauvreté et d’exclusion, de conflits et de catastrophes. Œuvrant aux côtés des personnes handicapées et vulnérabilisées, elle agit et témoigne pour répondre à leurs besoins essentiels et améliorer leurs conditions de vie. Elle s’engage à promouvoir le respect de leur dignité et de leurs droits fondamentaux. Depuis sa création en 1982, HI a mis en place des programmes de développement dans plus de 55 pays et intervient dans de nombreuses situations d’urgence. Aujourd'hui, nous avons un budget d'environ 200 millions d'euros, avec 4000 employés dans le monde.   Chez Handicap International, nous croyons fermement en l'importance de l'inclusion et de la diversité au sein de notre structure. C'est pourquoi nous sommes engagés dans une politique handicap afin de favoriser l'accueil et l'intégration de personnes en situation de handicap. Merci d’indiquer si vous avez besoin d’un aménagement particulier, y compris pour participer aux 1ers entretiens.   Retrouvez plus d’informations sur l’association : www.hi.org . OBJECTIFS DU POSTE : Au sein du département Plaidoyer et Institut de HI, sous la supervision de la Responsable du plaidoyer en matière de désarmement et de protection des civils, vous contribuez à la conception, la mise en œuvre, le suivi et la communication des stratégies mondiales de plaidoyer de HI sur le désarmement humanitaire et la protection des civils. Ce rôle a pour but de traduire les preuves et l'expérience de terrain en influence politique crédible, de relier le plaidoyer national et international, et de soutenir un engagement continu avec les États, les parlementaires, les institutions internationales, les réseaux, les associations nationales et les programmes de HI. Le poste évolue dans un environnement changeant et politiquement sensible, marqué par une pression sur le droit international humanitaire et les normes multilatérales de désarmement.   Dans ce cadre, vos missions principales sont :   ·        Contribuer à la stratégie, à la planification, au suivi et à la coordination interne du portefeuille Désarmement et Protection des civils. ·        Développer et mettre en œuvre un plaidoyer fondé sur des preuves concernant l'aide aux victimes, le Traité sur l'interdiction des mines, la Convention sur les armes à sous-munitions, les armes explosives dans les zones peuplées et les priorités connexes de protection des civils. ·        Relier les opportunités de plaidoyer à l'échelle mondiale avec les programmes, les associations nationales, les experts techniques, des survivants et d'autres personnes touchées par des violences explosives. ·        Engager les États, les parlementaires, les institutions de l'UE et internationales, ainsi que les réseaux de désarmement à travers des actions ciblées de sensibilisation et de représentation politique. ·        Soutenir les publications, les campagnes, la communication interne et externe, la collecte de fonds, le reporting des donateurs et un suivi budgétaire rigoureux. En détail, voici les missions : 1. Stratégie, orientation et surveillance ·        Contribuer à la préparation, au sui

Remote oder im Büro, Teil- oder Vollzeit, mit oder ohne Personalverantwortung. Gemeinsam finden wir auch das richtige Setting für dich. Auch wenn nicht alle Punkte auf dich zutreffen, wollen wir dich kennenlernen. Vielleicht stehst du als UI-Designer:in gerade vor der Herausforderung dich stärker in UX-Themen einzuarbeiten zu wollen. Bei uns bekommst du die Möglichkeiten und Unterstützung, die es dafür braucht. Sende uns einfach deine aussagekräftige Bewerbung mit Portfolio zu. Wir freuen uns auf den Austausch. Bitte füge in dein Anschreiben oder CV den Satz „Ich brenne für UI/UX“ ein, um zu zeigen, dass du unsere Stellenanzeige aufmerksam gelesen hast. jobs.title: Senior/Staff Data Analyst, Storefront
jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes&nbsp; and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.&nbsp; Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.&nbsp;</li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465">The ideal candidate is deeply analytical, highly curious, and motivated by using data science to shape the trajectory of fast-scaling international storefronts. They are skilled at uncovering the underlying drivers of customer behavior, business performance, and product outcomes, and translating those insights into clear opportunities for growth.</p> <p>They thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments where they are expected to move beyond reporting into proactive problem solving, experimentation, and strategic influence. This person is energized by building from zero-to-one, partnering closely with product, engineering, merchandising, and business teams to help new storefronts scale successfully.</p> <p>The ideal candidate combines strong technical depth in analytics and experimentation with strong business judgment. They are comfortable owning complex analytical initiatives end-to-end, influencing prioritization through data, and helping teams focus on the highest-leverage opportunities to improve customer experience and accelerate growth in emerging markets.</

jobs.description: Bei uns übernimmst Du die fachliche Verantwortung beim Aufbau und der Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Security und Infrastruktur. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit unserem bestehenden IT-Team zusammen und übernimmst die Verantwortung für Security-Themen. Du bekommst den Freiraum, technische Entscheidungen zu treffen, Security-Standards zu etablieren und unsere IT-Landschaft nachhaltig mitzugestalten. Aufgaben Definition von Security-Standards: Du entwickelst konkrete und verbindliche Vorgaben und Regeln für die sichere Gestaltung und den sicheren Betrieb der IT. IT-Infrastruktur & Monitoring : Du analysierst und optimierst unsere Linux- und Windows-Infrastruktur und steuerst das Monitoring von Verfügbarkeit, Leistung, Kapazitäten und Zuständen unserer Systeme. System Hardening & Vulnerability Management: Du erarbeitest sichere Konfigurationen für unsere Server, Clients und Betriebssysteme, um Schwachstellen vorzubeugen. Sicherheitsrelevante Ereignisse bewertest Du und leitest erforderliche Maßnahmen ein. Security-Bewertungen & technische Freigaben: Du prüfst neue Systeme auf Sicherheitsrisiken, leitest konkrete Anforderungen ab und triffst nachvollziehbare Freigabeentscheidungen. ISO 27001 & ISMS: Du wirkst maßgeblich am Aufbau unseres Informationssicherheitsmanagementsystems und an der Vorbereitung der ISO-27001-Zertifizierung mit. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Überführung regulatorischer und organisatorischer Anforderungen in wirksame technische Maßnahmen. Unterstützung des IT-Betriebs: Du unterstützt das Team bei betrieblichen Aufgaben und Störungen und trägst zu einer zuverlässigen Bereitstellung unserer IT-Services bei. jobs.title: CEO / Business Co-Founder (f/m/d) role at startup IXPLAIN
jobs.description: IXPLAIN Kaiserslautern, Germany (DFKI) | On-site / Hybrid | Co-Founder / Equity | Deep Tech / Explainable AI About iXplain iXplain is an AI platform for time series analysis that doesn't just detect what is happening in sensor data, but explains why. It combines state-of-the-art machine learning (classification, forecasting, regression, anomaly detection) with Explainable AI and a neuro-symbolic rule engine to turn raw industrial signals into clear, actionable recommendations, already demonstrated in water quality monitoring, energy grids and automotive production. **The opportunity **iXplain grew out of DFKI (German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence) and has a functional demonstrator, shown at Hannover Messe 2025, with live discussions underway in the water and manufacturing sectors. The technology is proven; the company is not yet founded. We are looking for a CEO / Business co-founder to turn a validated research demonstrator into a company, own the commercial relationship with our first industrial partners, and build the business around technology our 3-person research team has already built. Tasks What you will own Company build-up - Lead the incorporation of iXplain as a company and define its go-to-market strategy and business model. - Own fundraising strategy and investor relations for the seed stage. Commercial validation - Validate iXplain with real industrial partners in water, energy and automotive/manufacturing, turning early discussions (post-Hannover Messe 2025) into paying pilots. - Define how iXplain integrates into customers' existing workflows and systems. Business leadership - Build the commercial organization, pricing and sales process from scratch alongside the technical co-founders (Dr. Dominique Mercier, CTO; Dr. Tobias Wirth, Advisor). - Represent iXplain to investors, partners and industrial customers as CEO. Requirements What you bring Core experience - Entrepreneurial / business leadership experience, ideally as a founder or in early-stage B2B SaaS or industrial-tech commercialization. - Track record in business development and closing deals with industrial or enterprise customers. - Comfortable operating without a playbook, pre-product-market-fit. Especially valuable - Domain expertise in water, energy, or automotive/manufacturing industries. - Experience fundraising from VCs or deep-tech grants (e.g., EXIST, German public funding). - Ability to speak the language of both data-science researchers and industrial buyers. Benefits Why join iXplain - Own the CEO seat of a deep-tech AI company with a working, demonstrated product, not a slide deck. - Backed by DFKI's research and IP in Explainable AI and neuro-symbolic reasoning. - Equity-based co-founder role with real influence on strategy, hiring and company direction from day one. iXplain welcomes co-founder candidates regardless of gender, age, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability, sexual identity, or any other characteristic. jobs.description: We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Aircraft Painter to join our aviation maintenance team. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing and painting aircraft surfaces to meet high industry standards. As an Aircraft Painter, you will work on a variety of aircraft types, ensuring the external appearance and protective coating of the aircraft meet both aesthetic and regulatory standards. Your expertise in surface preparation, painting, and finishing will be crucial in ensuring aircraft are ready for operation and maintain their durability in various conditions. This role is essential for ensuring that aircraft are protected from environmental elements and have a visually appealing and professional finish. If you have an eye for detail and a passion for precision work, this is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the aviation industry. Key Responsibilities: Prepare aircraft surfaces for painting by cleaning, masking, and sanding areas to remove old paint or contaminants. Apply primers, base coats, and topcoats according to industry standards and manufacturer specifications. Use spray painting equipment to ensure even and accurate application of paint to aircraft surfaces. Follow precise instructions and blueprints to create custom designs, logos, or lettering on aircraft. Inspect painted surfaces for quality, ensuring proper thickness, gloss, and uniformity of color. Repair and touch up paintwork as necessary, ensuring aircraft meet regulatory and aesthetic standards. Maintain and clean painting equipment and tools, ensuring they are in proper working order. Comply with safety regulations, using appropriate protective gear and ensuring the workspace is safe and clean. Record and document all work performed, including materials used and procedures followed. Work with other maintenance team members to ensure the aircraft is ready for delivery on schedule. Ensure compliance with environmental regulations regarding the use of chemicals and hazardous materials. Assist in the development of painting schedules and timelines, ensuring that projects are completed on time. Qualifications: Proven experience as an Aircraft Painter or in a related role (e.g., automotive or industrial painting). Familiarity with aircraft painting techniques, materials, and procedures. Strong attention to detail with the ability to produce high-quality finishes. Knowledge of safety protocols related to handling hazardous chemicals and materials. Physical stamina and dexterity to work in confined spaces or at heights. Ability to work as part of a team and collaborate effectively with other technicians and engineers. Excellent time management and organizational skills. Preferred Qualifications: Experience working with a variety of aircraft types (commercial, military, private jets, etc.). Familiarity with corrosion prevention and metal treatment processes. Knowledge of environmentally safe painting products and techniques. Ability to apply complex custom designs, logos, or branding. Certification in aircraft painting or a relevant field (preferred but not mandatory depending on experience). Knowledge of relevant aviation regulatory standards (such as FAA or EASA guidelines) concerning painting and surface finishing. jobs.title: Senior Manager- Commercial Performance Improvement
jobs.description: About Unity Advisory Unity Advisory is a modern advisory business built for today's CFO. It combines deep expertise with an AI-native operating model designed to deliver better evidence, faster execution and stronger client outcomes. Through direct access to the expertise needed to solve complex challenges and a pace of delivery that enables organisations to seize opportunities, Unity delivers advisory as it should be, through a model that is free from audit conflict. The Role As a Senior Manager in our Deals and Value Capture team, you'll lead commercial performance improvement and value capture engagements for PE-backed and corporate clients across the deal and ownership lifecycle; from value-focused CDD and GTM diagnostics, through implementation and ongoing performance improvement, to exit readiness. Our work spans the full commercial operating system: market, customer and value proposition; GTM model and channel strategy; marketing and sales effectiveness; pricing and monetisation; customer success, retention and expansion; commercial operations and Lead-to-Cash; and AI, analytics and data enablement. You'll bring these levers together into a practical, integrated plan rather than treating them as separate workstreams. This is a hands-on delivery role. You'll lead workstreams day-to-day, build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and take ownership for moving from diagnosis to implementation. You'll also work closely with the Director/Partner group to shape the practice, feed in what is working on the ground and sharpen our proposition as we build it out. Key Responsibilities Lead end-to-end commercial performance improvement engagements, spanning value-focused GTM diagnostics, value capture execution, and ongoing performance improvement. Diagnose where commercial value is created or lost using customer, commercial, operational and financial qualitative and quantitative data points; quantify the opportunity and link recommendations to revenue, margin, EBITDA and cash outcomes. Design and deliver work across market segmentation, ICP and value proposition; GTM and channel strategy; marketing effectiveness; sales productivity, pipeline and forecasting; pricing and monetisation; and customer success, retention and expansion. Help clients to build the commercial operating system required to sustain improvement, including GTM processes, commercial governance and operating cadence, and KPI definitions and incentives. Translate analysis into execution through prioritised value cases, 100-day plans, pilots, playbooks, sales motions, adoption measures and benefits tracking, taking ownership for delivered outcomes, not just recommendations. Create clear, decision-ready materials for management teams, boards and investors, including KPI baselines, performance dashboards, value creation roadmaps and diligence-ready evidence packs. Manage day-to-day client relationships with senior stakeholders across commercial, finance, operations, technology and data, acting as the primary point of contact for engagement delivery. Project manage multidisciplinary engagement teams, ensuring quality, pace and commercial impact while coaching and developing junior team members. Contribute to proposals and pitches, including scoping, costing and drafting client-ready materials; identify follow-on opportunities within existing client relationships. Develop Unity's commercial performance improvement IP, tools and methodology based on live engagement experience and reusable approaches across the portfolio. Qualifications 8-10 years of consulting or relevant industry experience in front-office, GTM, commercial transformation or performance improvement. A track record of leading commercial transformation or value creation engagements from diagnosis through implementation, ideally including PE-backed portfolio company work. jobs.title: Broker Development Manager
jobs.description: ABOUT FLOCK Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! THE ROLE Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission. WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE: Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel. A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING: Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success. Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets. Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential. Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors. Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance. Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business. Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives. Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission. Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin. WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK: ESSENTIAL A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry. Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives. An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm. Our frontier model, Interpreter, is the world's first AI purpose-built to understand vehicle damage and the parts needed to fix it. Partly.ai is the AI tool for repairers, built on top of that infrastructure, that makes finding and sourcing the right part feel like magic. No general-purpose AI model comes close on parts accuracy, and that is what makes agentic procurement automation possible at the precision the repair industry demands. Automotive data is scattered around the world in complex, inconsistent formats, and the interesting work is in unifying it into something that drives a customer's business. You'll sit between Sales, Product, and Engineering, resolving the technical blockers that stand between a prospect and a deal, building demos and experimental features that show off what Interpreter can do, and shaping how the product gets built for and applied to each new market. Why join now: Partly closed a $50M Series B at a $500M valuation and is scaling fast across the UK, Europe, the U.S., and Australasia, in a $1.9 trillion industry that has barely been touched by modern software. You'd be early, close to the founders and the model, and given real ownership from day one. FDEs embed directly with the client’s engineering teams to design, build, and deliver production-ready implementations of Vault and associated products. jobs.title: Project Engineer (Data Centres & Industrials)
jobs.description: About the role Octopus is building a new business line delivering low-cost, reliable, clean energy and faster speed-to-power for data centres and large industrials. We're looking for a Project Electrical Engineer to be the electrical owner on first-of-a-kind power projects - private wire, behind-the-meter generation and storage, MV and HV grid connections. This is a technical role with a unique expanded scope to broader infrastructure project management. Early on you are the project manager: you hold the programme, the development budget and the external parties, from concept design through connection offer to design freeze and financial close. From there you stay on as the electrical owner through construction, commissioning and energisation, with a delivery team around you. What you'll do Own the programme and the development budget. Schedule from early concept to design freeze - siting, connection application, planning, consents, procurement, long-lead items - worked back from the customer's energisation date. Appoint and manage consultants, ICPs and study providers. Surface risk early and clearly communicate them to the stakeholders. Own the electrical concept through to sign-off. Single-line diagrams, general arrangements, switchgear and plant layouts, cable routes, metering and comms architecture. Direct and interrogate the studies (load flow, short-circuit, protection coordination, arc flash, earthing, power quality). Chair design reviews and stage gates, and take options to the Project Lead and customer with a recommendation. Lead the grid interface. DNO, TO and NESO - applications and offers, technical requirements, securities and milestones, contestable and non-contestable scope, ICP/IDNO coordination, MPAN registration. Budget ownership through completion. Credible capex inputs for the project model across plant, substation, civils and enabling works, with value engineering and optioneering. Then FAT/SAT witnessing, commissioning plans and sequences of operation, energisation and handover. Take on what you haven't done before. First-of-a-kind means no precedent, no standard design and no colleague who's done it. Get to a working understanding of an unfamiliar technology or scope fast, and deliver it. What you'll have Master’s degree , or equivalent, in electrical or power systems engineering. CEng welcome, not essential. 5+ years delivering energy or infrastructure projects, with a strong grounding in MV and HV systems. Real infrastructure experience - substations, networks, industrial plant, data centres, utilities, water or transport. We care that you've dealt with ground conditions, easements, consents, tie-ins to live assets and construction sequencing. This is not a grid-only role. You've personally held a programme and a budget on a development or pre-construction project. A GB/European grid connection taken from connection offer to grid code compliance and energisation, with working knowledge of the Grid Code, CUSC, SQSS, G99/G100, ENA engineering recommendations and BS 7671. Able to coordinate a multi-discipline design where you're not the expert in every discipline - and to spot a weak answer from a civil or mechanical engineer. Comfortable as the single point of accountability with an incomplete picture, holding external parties accountable without formal authority. Full UK driving licence and willing to travel to site.   It would be great if you have...   BESS, private wire, microgrid or behind-the-meter generation; data centre or mission-critical power (MV/LV distribution, UPS, generators, redundancy topologies, commissioning levels); study tools (ETAP, PowerFactory, IPSA, PSS/E, PSCAD) or Python; IEC 61850, Modbus, DNP3, SCADA and metering data flows; NEC or FIDIC contract and change management. Project management credentials (APM, PRINCE2, MS Project, Primavera) - though we care far more about what you've delivered. Why else you'll love it here •  Wondering what the salary for this role

jobs.description: Octopus is a rapidly growing, global energy business. We are looking for a grid analyst with a passion for understanding and designing electricity grids. Techno-economic and electrical power flow modeling to define optimal mix of resources against specific objectives (grid constraints, peak profile, LOLE, LCOE etc.) Technical assessment of solutions for grid quality and stability issues, with a focus on non-wire solutions (flexibility and BESS).  Grid development plans: support the team in reviewing and designing grid investment plans or Integrated Resource Plans, for technical sign-off.  Interconnection: Analyse grid constraints and provide insights on grid connection queues.  Interest in expanding into commercial modelling What you'll need Strong background in energy systems. Ability to run or develop deterministic physics based grid modeling tools. Knowledge of linear, economic modelling, e.g. plexos, is a plus.  Experience with DERs, medium and high voltage grids and utility-scale energy projects. Deep understanding of energy economics and grid infrastructure principles, enjoys generating insights from large and complex sets of energy data and metrics. Enjoys starting things from scratch, pro-actively look (and find) data, and iterating quickly Natural curiosity and passion for all things grid and the energy transition   How you’ll make an impact: Inquisitive and seek to really understand the question – on top of your technical skills you seek to understand the true requirements of a problem and approach the answers with a business and user mindset. Proactive – much of work will be unguided as you develop the tools and capabilities to answer businesses questions.   Our data platform stack: Python as our main programming language. Databricks as our data lake platform. Kubernetes for data services and task orchestration. Terraform for infrastructure. Streamlit for data applications. Airflow purely for job scheduling and tracking. Circle CI for continuous deployment. Parquet and Delta file formats on S3 for data lake storage. Spark for data processing. DBT for data modelling. SparkSQL for analytics. Why else you'll love it here •  Wondering what the salary for this role is? Just ask us! The reason why we don't advertise is because we honestly have a degree of flexibility and would never want salary to be a reason why someone doesn't apply to Octopus - what's more important to us is finding the right octofit!

As part of Octopus Energy Group, we’re creating an innovative approach to trading that will accelerate the transition to a Net Zero world. With the growth of renewables and a push toward decarbonising heating and transport, greater flexibility in the grid is essential. We are building cutting-edge technology to optimise everything from domestic EV charging to grid-scale batteries, to meet the global demand for energy flexibility. We’re looking for passionate and unconventional thinkers to join us on this journey, bringing a diversity of experience and ideas to shape a more efficient, flexible, and sustainable energy system. With an increase in variable and distributed supply, using data for trading and forecasting has never been more important. Octopus has always had a tech-first approach, and our trading and analytics tools are all built in-house. We are looking for a data scientist who’s comfortable building data pipelines bringing together internal and external data to create market leading insights using both classical and ML techniques. This will include looking at demand, renewables and transmission system fundamentals forecasts focussed to begin with on the GB intraday power market. What You'll Do Exploring the types of data needed to effectively trade the GB intraday power market Building, improving and maintaining models to forecast electricity demand and renewable generation, primarily in GB but developing into all of Western Europe; Finding high quality, novel data sources to base our forecasts off of; Development on forecasting framework and tools; Maintaining and automating forecasting processes, whilst building in checks and alerting; Utilising these forecasting models to build or enhance our price forecasts Collaborating with Trading, Renewables, Flexibility and other teams to utilise our combined knowledge and data. What You'll Need Experience with Python is essential; A good understanding of what forecasting techniques to use and the ability to build a simple baseline and quickly iterate; Ability to communicate your approach, including its strengths and limitations; Able to quickly understand commercial and industry concepts; Team player excited at the idea of ownership across lots of different projects and tools; Passion for driving towards Net Zero; Experience with Machine Learning is essential; Experience in the electricity industry in GB would be useful but not required. 💚 Why else you'll love it here 💚   •  💰 Wondering what the salary for this role is?  Just ask us! jobs.title: Commercial Analyst (Data Centres and Industrials)
jobs.description: About the role Octopus is building a new business line delivering low-cost, reliable, clean energy and faster speed-to-power for datacenters and large industrials. The deals are first-of-a-kind: private wire, behind-the-meter generation and storage, flexible load, novel grid connections. This is a quantitative role with direct exposure to large-scale innovative power projects. You'll own the project model, build pricing strategies and directly participate to final investment decisions. What you'll do Own the project model for each opportunity - generation, BESS, flexible load, network cost; capex, opex, revenue stack, IRR, downside cases. Build project-specific models while developing toolings and standard assumptions to support our growing pipeline Price the offer. Turn a customer's load profile and reliability requirement into a deliverable price and structure - tariff, PPA, tolling, availability-based - and show which one allocates risk sensibly for both sides. Value the flex. Model storage and flexible load across wholesale, Balancing Mechanism, ancillary services and Capacity Market. Quantify network charges (TNUoS, DUoS, BSUoS), curtailment and connection options. Develop the business case. Build internal and external presentations to support from indicative customer proposals to project final investment decisions. Track the portfolio and read the market. Monitor live projects against approved cases - spend, milestones, connection dates - and identify early and quantify regulatory change (connections reform, REMA, network charging). Support term sheets and diligence from indicative to signed. What you'll need 3–5 years in a numerate commercial role - infrastructure or renewables development, project finance, banking, energy trading or origination, strategy or energy consultancy. Financial modelling from first principles: DCF, IRR, scenarios and sensitivities. You can build a model someone else can follow and eventually develop it as a standard tool for other team members to use. Advanced knowledge of GB/European power markets, and how network and connection costs land on a project. Advanced Excel and Python Able to take a messy, incomplete problem to a clear recommendation Quantitative degree - economics, engineering, finance, maths, physics - or equivalent experience.   It would be nice if you have...   Datacenters, large industrial load or behind-the-meter/private wire projects; BESS revenue stacking; a PPA, tolling or connection agreement taken to signature; Aurora, PLEXOS or equivalent. jobs.title: Responsable Partenariats Terrain B2B H/F
jobs.description: 🐙 Rejoins la révolution énergétique chez Octopus Energy ! Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et sans sous-traitance. Tu veux un job qui a du sens ? Octopus Energy Services a démarré son activité en 2024, avec un objectif clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance ! Contexte et objectifs de la mission Afin de consolider sa croissance et d'accompagner au mieux ses clients dans la transition énergétique, Octopus Energy lance son programme de "Partenaires Certifiés". Notre ambition est de créer un réseau national d'artisans de confiance (experts en solaire, pompes à chaleur, véhicules électriques, etc.) pour proposer un parcours fluide à nos clients (travaux + fourniture d'énergie + pilotage). En tant que responsable des partenaires, tu rejoins une "task force" de 3 personnes dédiée au lancement de cette nouvelle activité. Ton but ? Être le fer de lance commercial de ce projet. En véritable “intrapreneur·se” sur un projet où tout reste à construire, tu auras la charge de structurer, d'animer et de faire grandir ce réseau de partenaires stratégiques. Missions principales Prospection & signature : identifier, cibler et convaincre nos cibles prioritaires (notamment les partenaires Tiers 1) en fonction de nos marchés (pompes à chaleur, solaire, véhicules électriques, etc.) afin d'assurer la signature de nouveaux accords stratégiques. Gestion de comptes & animation au quotidien : reprendre la gestion de nos 15 partenaires historiques et assurer l'onboarding, le suivi régulier et l'animation des nouveaux artisans signés. Tu seras leur point de contact privilégié pour les accompagner et garantir leur productivité sur nos offres. Ambassadeur terrain & co-construction : en tant que véritable porte-parole du terrain, tu es responsable d'identifier, de qualifier et de faire remonter les "pain points" (irritants) des artisans. De nombreux déplacements sont à prévoir à l'échelle nationale (France métropolitaine) pour aller à la rencontre de notre réseau et le développer. Ton quotidien, c’est l’action ! Prospecter & convaincre  : À la rencontre de nouveaux clients, en porte-à-porte ou en stand. Chaque porte est une opportunité. Accompagner & conseiller : Aide les foyers à réduire leur facture et leur impact grâce à des économies d'énergie et des écogestes simples . La meilleure école de vente : Écouter, pitcher, s'adapter, signer. Chaque contrat activé = une commission directe. S'amuser, avant tout : Sur le terrain, en stand, en équipe. On célèbre chaque victoire, petite ou grande ! Ce poste est fait pour toi si : Tu as le  contact humain  et les échanges sincères sont dans ta nature. Pas d'expérience dans l'énergie ? Aucun souci : on te forme. L'envie, elle, ne s'apprend pas. Ce qu'on te promet : La reconnaissance  : Ton travail est vu, valorisé et célébré. Une rémunération et des avantages qui donnent envie : Un fixe attractif selon ton expérience et ton profil. Un variable non plafonné : mieux tu vends, plus tu gagnes. Des primes de performance & qualité + des challenges toute l'année. Une prime de formation à la validation de la période d'essai. Et de vrais plus : intéressement au capital, excellente mutuelle (Alan), forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge des transports au-delà du légal, congés pour projet associatif et équipement fourni. Et la cerise sur le gâteau : Octopus Energy Nous, on veut faire passer tout le monde au vert, dans une entreprise qui met le client au cœur de tout.
